checks.scope: Returned native family; a source-preservation envelope is not native admission.
Exact authored identity multiset, including duplicate and omitted identities.
Authored identity-to-label binding; NFC/whitespace normalization applies to display labels, never identity strings.
Exact endpoint/direction/declared-marker/label multiset; parallel and reciprocal relationships remain distinct.
Exact immediate membership and label binding; nested groups are identities, not flattened leaves.
Independently declared family content with meaningful ordering retained.

limitations: Prepared occupied text regions bound native geometry; exact glyph ink depends on the resolved font.
Declared transparency, intentional data-mark overlap and externally modified CSS are outside this proof.

checks.scope: Actual public SVG result
Duplicate SVG identities can change marker, clip and owned-label references
Actual browser viewport of the returned SVG
Computed visibility and nonzero browser text bounds; metadata/title/defs text earns no credit

checks.expected: every authored label fits the canvas
checks.scope: Actual rendered label bounds, with 1.5 CSS-pixel serialization tolerance
Actual self/ancestor clipping and overflow; unprojected masks/clip paths remain unavailable
Visible geometric elements; unprojected use/HTML/image-only ink remains unavailable, not a drawing defect
Unique actual label-to-shape ownership, independently of native model identity

Owned outline/lifeline endpoint proximity and exact multiplicity. Clearance is at most max(2 CSS pixels, half the observed painted marker length), capped at 8; this is not a strict physical-touch certificate
Actual triangle/arrow/diamond/circle glyph geometry and marker ownership; a decoration is not automatically a directed arrow
Authored descendant nodes fit their actual owned group boundary; immediate membership is checked independently in the native model
Authored descendant nodes fit their actual owned group boundary; immediate membership is checked independently in the native model
Authored descendant nodes fit their actual owned group boundary; immediate membership is checked independently in the native model
Unresolved paint servers/context colors cannot silently earn a visible-ink or complete-style claim

contactCounts.reason: No enrolled exact SVG node-boundary contact observer

browserCenterline.scope: Browser getTotalLength sum in local SVG units, only length-preserving ancestor transforms; curve length is browser approximation, excludes markers/labels

linear.scope: Existing strict untransformed orthogonal absolute M/L, polyline, or line SVG observer; authored-endpoint crossing exclusions retained
